_comment: Immigration interview question DAG — IMM-06. Edit this file to add/remove questions without code changes.

sections.title: Personal Identity
sections.description: Basic personal details as they appear on your travel documents.

sections.title: Address History
sections.description: Your current and previous addresses over the last 5 years.

sections.title: Family & Dependents
sections.description: Spouse, partner, and any dependents joining you.

questions.label: What is your legal first name?
questions.help_text: As it appears on your passport — no nicknames.

questions.label: What is your legal last name (surname)?
questions.help_text: As it appears on your passport.

questions.label: Do you have any middle names?
questions.help_text: Leave blank if none. Include all middle names as they appear on your passport.

questions.label: What is your date of birth?
questions.help_text: Format: DD/MM/YYYY

questions.label: What is your place of birth?
questions.help_text: City and country, e.g. 'Paris, France'

questions.label: What gender is listed on your passport?
questions.help_text: Select the gender marker as it appears on your travel document.

questions.label: What is your nationality?
questions.help_text: Your primary nationality as shown on your passport (e.g. French, German, British).

questions.label: Do you hold a second nationality?
questions.help_text: This affects which documents you may use to enter certain countries.

questions.label: What is your second nationality?
questions.help_text: As shown on your second passport or ID document.

questions.label: What is your marital status?
questions.help_text: This determines which family documents may be required.

questions.label: Have you had any visa or entry permit refusals in the last 10 years?
questions.help_text: Including tourist, work, or study visas for any country. This must be disclosed — omissions may cause visa rejection.

questions.label: What is your highest educational qualification?
questions.help_text: Required for most skilled worker and Blue Card visa applications.

questions.label: Upload a photo of your passport data page
questions.help_text: The page with your photo, name, and MRZ lines. JPEG, PNG, or WebP, max 10 MB. We will auto-fill fields from the image.

questions.label: What is your passport number?
questions.help_text: Exactly as printed on the data page — no spaces.

questions.label: What is your passport expiry date?
questions.help_text: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your visa end date.

questions.label: When was your passport issued?
questions.help_text: The 'Date of Issue' or 'Date of Delivery' on the data page.

questions.label: Which country issued your passport?
questions.help_text: ISO 3-letter code or full country name (e.g. FRA, GBR, DEU).

questions.label: Do you currently hold a visa or residence permit for the destination country?
questions.help_text: Enter the visa type if applicable (e.g. 'Tourist Schengen', 'Blue Card', 'Skilled Worker') or leave blank.

questions.label: When does your current visa or permit expire?
questions.help_text: Required so your relocation can be timed before expiry.

questions.label: Where did you obtain your highest qualification?
questions.help_text: Name of the university or institution, and country.

questions.label: What is your current home address?
questions.help_text: Your permanent residential address. This is used to determine consulate jurisdiction.

questions.label: Have you lived at any other address in the past 5 years?
questions.help_text: Most visa applications require a complete 5-year address history.

questions.label: Please list all addresses you have lived at in the past 5 years
questions.help_text: Include start and end dates for each address. We will flag any gaps over 30 days.

questions.label: Will any family members or dependents be relocating with you?
questions.help_text: Includes spouse, civil partner, and children.

questions.label: What is your spouse or partner's full legal name?
questions.help_text: As it appears on their passport.

questions.label: What is your spouse or partner's nationality?
questions.help_text: Different nationality may require separate visa applications.

questions.label: What is your spouse or partner's date of birth?
questions.help_text: Required for dependent visa applications.

questions.label: Please provide details for each dependent joining you
questions.help_text: For each child or dependent: full name, date of birth, nationality, and relationship.

questions.label: Emergency contact details
questions.help_text: Name, relationship, and phone number of someone to contact in an emergency.
